timeline.text: Welcome to this session. I will guide you through each tapping point. At every point, you will hear a short phrase. Repeat it aloud, or quietly inside your head. Let us begin.

timeline.ins: Begin tapping on the side of your hand.
timeline.say: I am about to walk into a room where I know no one.

timeline.ins: Now tap the top of your head.
timeline.say: My mind is imagining every awkward possibility.

timeline.ins: Move to the beginning of your eyebrows.
timeline.say: I feel nervous about being on my own here.

timeline.ins: Now tap at the side of your eyes.
timeline.say: I keep scanning for a familiar face that is not there.

timeline.ins: Move under your eyes.
timeline.say: My body feels tense before I even walk in.

timeline.ins: Now tap under your nose.
timeline.say: I want to feel confident instead of exposed.

timeline.ins: Move to your chin.
timeline.say: Part of me wants to turn around and leave.

timeline.ins: Now tap your collarbones.
timeline.say: I can admit that this feels intimidating.

timeline.ins: Finish this round under your arm.
timeline.say: Walking in alone feels like a lot right now.

timeline.text: Take one easy breath. Notice whether anything has shifted, even slightly. If nothing has changed yet, that is completely okay. Keep breathing, and we will continue.

timeline.ins: Return to the side of your hand.
timeline.say: I can walk in without needing to know everyone.

timeline.ins: Tap the top of your head.
timeline.say: Most people here feel a little nervous too.

timeline.ins: Move to the beginning of your eyebrows.
timeline.say: I do not have to perform, just be present.

timeline.ins: Tap at the side of your eyes.
timeline.say: I can find one person or one moment to anchor to.

timeline.ins: Move under your eyes.
timeline.say: My body can settle as I move through the room.

timeline.ins: Tap under your nose.
timeline.say: I am allowed to ease in slowly.

timeline.ins: Move to your chin.
timeline.say: Being new here does not make me out of place.

timeline.ins: Tap your collarbones.
timeline.say: I can be myself, even among strangers.

timeline.ins: Finish this round under your arm.
timeline.say: I can let this feel less big than it seems.

timeline.text: Take another slow breath. Notice what feels different now. You do not need the feeling to disappear. See if there is simply a little less pressure, or a little more choice in how you meet this moment.

timeline.ins: Return to the side of your hand.
timeline.say: I am capable of walking into this room.

timeline.ins: Tap the top of your head.
timeline.say: My mind can stay steady, even here.

timeline.ins: Move to the beginning of your eyebrows.
timeline.say: I trust myself to find connection.

timeline.ins: Tap at the side of your eyes.
timeline.say: I can be curious instead of afraid.

timeline.ins: Move under your eyes.
timeline.say: My body can feel grounded in this space.

timeline.ins: Tap under your nose.
timeline.say: I belong wherever I choose to show up.

timeline.ins: Move to your chin.
timeline.say: I do not need to know everyone to feel okay.

timeline.ins: Tap your collarbones.
timeline.say: I can carry my own steadiness into this room.

timeline.ins: Finish under your arm.
timeline.say: I am ready to walk in.

timeline.text: Let your hands rest, and take one full breath. Notice how you feel now, without needing to judge it. Thank you for taking this time for yourself. Carry this steadiness with you as you continue.
